# Thunderbird Try failure-causality analysis with conservative unknowns

The password-manager signature `the visibility toggle button should be disabled with no saved passwords - false == true` was introduced by an earlier outgoing-stack assertion in several runs, not target commits such as `0c6cedb`/`6787a1ac`; still preserve `unknown` for an entire job with unexplained additional failures. `LoadSignons()` is asynchronous, so the assertion can race. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
